rules.text: The keys are a Rhodes held as a pad: each chord held through its bar, soft attack, never short or choppy hits
rules.said: the keys are way too bright and have too much attack for lofi / they are now choppy hits, not sustained / use a rhodes pad instead → much better

rules.text: No Waveshaper or other distortion on the master
rules.said: (the producer's review: the waveshaper on the master was part of what made lofi worse)

rules.text: A wash or pad sound is never a lead or arpeggio; a lead is clear with a defined attack
rules.said: that wash arp sound should never be used as a lead

rules.text: The melody is soothing (a vibraphone), an octave lower than a bright lead would sit
rules.said: switch that walking melody instrument for something more soothing / vibraphone down 1 octave

rules.text: In a gradual change new drums fade in over the bars while the old fade out, never jumping in
rules.said: the lofi drums jumped in stead of fading in gradually

rules.text: Lofi drums are TR-808 drums, soft, swung and low-passed; not a jazz kit
rules.said: 808s would be better for lofi hip hop than the jazz kit

rules.text: Lofi bass is the early sessions' Cubed with the squelch taken out (cutoff 0.28, resonance 0.05, env mod 0.2, accent 0.4, decay 0.6), low-passed: a low attack, smooth, sustained and warm; never a sampled finger or fretless bass
rules.said: whatever bass was originally used for lofi was better than fretless; (2026-11-27) i want that to be the default. it was not finger bass style. low attack, smooth sustained warm sound

rules.text: The lofi Rhodes is audible through the whole song, held as a pad, one chord per bar at a clear level; never let it drop to a single stab or go inaudible.
rules.said: can't hear the rhodes except for 1 stab

rules.text: Hip hop leads are never a harmonica or a reedy, nasal tone (the Muted Trumpet sounds like one); use a clear, warm, defined-attack lead sound for boom bap.
rules.said: that harmonica sound is horrible for hip hop
